title: distancemap
description: A tool to calculate distance maps using FSL

input_image.description: Input image filename (calc distance to non-zero voxels)
input_image.title: Input image

mask_image.description: Mask image filename (only calc values at these voxels)
mask_image.title: Mask image

second_image.description: Second image filename (calc closest distance of this and primary input image, using non-zero voxels, negative distances mean this secondary image is the closer one)
second_image.title: Second image

segmented_image.description: Segmented output image filename (unique value per segment is local maxima label)
segmented_image.title: Segmented image

interpolate_values.description: Filename for values to interpolate (sparse sampling interpolation)
interpolate_values.title: Interpolate values
